title: Ashfang Underling
wikitext:
{{Infobox/Mob |stats = {{InfoboxMobStats |health = 2,000,000 |damage = 1,000 }} |mob_level = 175 |spawn_location = [[Ruins of Ashfang]] |mob_type = {{MobType|Infernal}} |id = ASHFANG_RED_BLAZE_150 }} An '''Ashfang Underling''' is a [[Mob]] that spawns while fighting {{MobSprite|Ashfang}} in the {{Zone|Ruins of Ashfang}} in the {{Zone|Crimson Isle}}. == Spawning == {{Main|Ashfang}} Four '''Ashfang Underlings''' spawn during {{MobSprite|Ashfang}}'s "[[#Ashfang#Summons Phase|Summons Phase]]". The phase initially occurs when Ashfang is first attacked, as well as repeatedly throughout the fight, each time lasting {{Green|50}} seconds. == Behavior == '''Ashfang Underlings''' can only be attacked from non-{{DamageType|Melee}} attacks. They use various attack methods against nearby players, including the following: * [[File:Fire Charge.png|21px|link=]] {{red|Fireball}}: Shoots six fireballs at the player, dealing {{stat|Damage|1,000}} on impact. * [[File:Obsidian.png|21px|link=y]] {{red|Noxious Ash Cloud}}: occasionally lob an {{ID|Obsidian}} block, lingering for {{green|5}} seconds before dissipating. This deals {{DamageType|Wither|1,000}} every second for {{green|10}} seconds, which is refreshed upon re-entering the cloud. * They do not try and follower the player, and therefore stay still. * If they are attacked for a few seconds, they will teleport away from the player. After the {{Green|50}} seconds of the [[#Ashfang#Summons Phase|Summons Phase]] are up, each {{MobSprite|Ashfang}} summon will be re-absorbed, healing Ashfang for {{Stat|Health|250,000}} per summon. == Drops == {{Mob Drops Table |level = 175 |combat_xp = 262 |coins = 58 |orbs = 192 }} Upon killing an '''Ashfang Underling''', {{MobSprite|Ashfang Follower}}, or {{MobSprite|Ashfang Acolyte}}, a [[File:Burning Eye (v1).png|21px|link=]]{{orange|Blazing Soul}} will spawn at its death location, which despawns after {{green|10}} seconds. Punching one launches it in the direction the player is facing. If it hits {{MobSprite|Ashfang}}, it deals a static {{si|dmg|2,000,000}}. == History == {{History table |ahn= {{history|2026/July 15 |Nerfed Ashfang's healing per Blaze absorbed from {{Stat|Health|500,000}} to {{Stat|Health|250,000}}. |Nerfed Ashfang's blases from {{Stat|Health|10,000,000}} to {{Stat|Health|2,000,000}}. }} {{History|2026/Aug 25|Changed the [[Mob Level]] from {{Level|150}} to {{Level|175}}, {{Coins}} from {{Gold|0}} to {{Gold|58}}, {{Experience}} from {{Dark Aqua|0}} to {{Dark Aqua|192}}, and {{Skill|Combat}} XP from {{Dark Aqua|10}} to {{Dark Aqua|262}}.}} |beta= {{History|0.13|[[File:Ashfang Underling.png|26px]] Added '''Ashfang Underling'''.}} {{history|0.26.1 |Nerfed Ashfang's healing per Blaze absorbed from {{Stat|Health|500,000}} to {{Stat|Health|250,000}}. |Nerfed Ashfang's blazes from {{Stat|Health|10,000,000}} to {{Stat|Health|2,000,000}}. }} {{History|0.27.2|Changed the [[Mob Level]] from {{Level|150}} to {{Level|175}}, {{Coins}} from {{Gold|0}} to {{Gold|58}}, {{Experience}} from {{Dark Aqua|0}} to {{Dark Aqua|192}}, and {{Skill|Combat}} XP from {{Dark Aqua|10}} to {{Dark Aqua|262}}.}} }} == References == [[File:Burning Eye (v1).png|21px|link=]]{{orange|Blazing Souls}} are ineffective against {{MobSprite|Ashfang Underling|alt={{red|Ashfang Underlings}}}}. {{Cite Discord |staff=yes |url=https://discord.com/channels/651912910972649492/1529181650641228007/1547023709032816660 |user=mrkeith |date=09/08/26, 9:19 PM (EST) |text= What's the damage value of the Noxious Ash Cloud ability used by Ashfang's minions? It seems to be based on the player's max health but I can't say anything more about it. 
seems to be on a per blaze basis:
```
ENTITY | DMG
---
ASHFANG | 5000
ASHFANG_BLUE | 1000
ASHFANG_RED | 1000
```

Damage is dealt as WITHER damage every second for 10 seconds, refreshed if a cloud is re-entered. I'm not seeing why it would deal damage based on max health.
Only Ashfang Minions seem to use the Noxious Ash Cloud ability but the chat message says they come from the Ashfang twins directly…who's the real caster here ? 
Both Ashfang and Red / Blue Blazes can cast the cloud, damage table above
